transcript.content: Hello, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?
I’m just so worn out. Walking from the bedroom to the kitchen feels like I’ve been hauling lumber all day, and resting doesn’t seem to give me anything back.
Have you been feeling down or depressed lately?
Yeah. I wake up with this heavy, hopeless feeling in my chest. Some days I just sit out in the garage and cry, and I don’t even know what set it off.
Have you lost interest or pleasure in things you usually enjoy?
Yeah. I used to look forward to choir, playing pickup ball, working on cars, grilling for the family. Now I just… I can’t make myself care enough to go, or even answer people’s texts.
Has anyone told you that you snore loudly or stop breathing in your sleep?
I’m not really sure. No one’s mentioned that to me.
Before this started, was there a time when you felt back to your usual self for at least a couple of months?
No. It’s been about four months now, since my wife went back to working full-time and I started being alone most weekdays. I haven’t really felt like myself in that time.
Have you had thoughts that life isn’t worth living?
Yeah. I keep thinking I should just be dead. When I’m alone, it scares me, because I start thinking I might actually do something to make that happen.
Do you intend to kill yourself?
I… I don’t know. The thought that I should be dead keeps coming back, and when I’m alone I get scared I might actually do something.
Have you made a plan for how you would kill yourself?
I don’t have a specific plan. It’s more that I keep thinking I should be dead, and when I’m by myself I get scared I might do something.
Have you done anything to get ready to kill yourself?
No, I haven’t done anything to get ready. But the thought that I should be dead keeps coming back, and when I’m alone I get scared I might actually do something.
Have you had a noticeable change in your appetite?
I’m not really sure. I haven’t noticed a clear change in my appetite.
Have you been moving or speaking noticeably slower than usual?
Yeah. Everything I do feels slowed down, like I’m moving through mud. And when someone asks me something, I hear them, but it can take me a long time to get the words out.
Have you been having trouble concentrating?
I’m not sure. I haven’t really noticed any particular trouble concentrating.
Have you lost weight without trying?
I don’t think so. I haven’t noticed my weight changing.
Have you been sleeping more than usual?
I’m not really sure. I haven’t noticed myself sleeping more than I usually do.
Have you been feeling worthless lately?
Yes. I keep thinking I failed my wife, my kids, and my church. It feels like every bad thing happening around us is punishment because I wasn’t the man I was supposed to be.
Have you been unusually sensitive to cold lately?
No, I haven’t really noticed being more sensitive to cold.
Have you been feeling this depressed nearly every day?
Yes, nearly every day. I wake up with this heavy, hopeless feeling in my chest, and some days I just sit in the garage and cry without even knowing why it started.
Do you believe God is punishing you for your shortcomings?
Yes... I do. I feel like I let my wife, my kids, and my church down, and that the bad things happening are punishment because I wasn’t the man I should have been.
Are you certain that God is punishing you?
Yes. I mean... I keep coming back to it. I failed my wife, my kids, and my church, and it feels like the bad things happening are punishment for not being the man I was supposed to be.
Can anyone convince you that God is not punishing you, or are you completely certain that it is true?

I don't think anyone could convince me right now. I keep thinking I failed my wife, my kids, and my church, and every bad thing that happens feels like punishment for not being the man I was supposed to be.
